title: Uploads served as their names say, and only trusted extensions' code as scripts
steps: Upload a .txt (Upload a file…). Open .common-ink/uploads.json, change that upload's "type" to "text/javascript" and save. Open /uploads/<its name>: DevTools shows Content-Type text/plain.
Customize a built-in in Extensions (Word count from the Catalog won't do: it runs sandboxed). The copy loads as before.
Every response has Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000 (DevTools > Network).
